title: Conversation reaches enough information for conclusion
description: The group signals it is concluding while important items are unresolved. Surface the remaining blockers — not a summary.
objective: Decide whether this idea deserves further validation and identify the biggest unknowns.

lines.text: Who would actually pay for this — team leads or the company?
Why wouldn't Microsoft just build this into Copilot?
Does Zoom offer a real-time transcript API for apps?
Yes, Zoom has a real-time media streams API that apps can use, we prototyped with it last year.
The technical side seems feasible for a prototype.
So where does that leave us? Is it worth validating?
